evidence.title: Same Agent, Different Answers: A Repeat-Aware Audit of Corpus-Induced Answer Churn in Retrieval-Augmented QA

summary: Researchers audit how retrieval-augmented QA systems produce varying answers for the same query when the underlying corpus changes. The findings highlight reliability challenges in AI-driven question-answering systems.
title: Study Reveals Inconsistencies in AI Answers Due to Corpus Changes in Retrieval-Augmented QA
